nodes.label: Current Capability Scope Shrink
nodes.rationale: Only the active capability may remove frozen facade scopes so serialized migration cannot hide concurrent business-behavior changes.

nodes.label: Future Capability Static Baseline
nodes.rationale: Future capability records must remain equivalent to the frozen baseline until their stage becomes current.

nodes.label: Current-Stage Persistence Call Non-Growth
nodes.rationale: Current-stage persistence calls may only stay at or below their frozen source-revision count, preventing a facade from gaining another writer while it shrinks.

nodes.label: Future-Stage Operation Immutability
nodes.rationale: Future-stage operation digests and persistence-call counts remain exact until their capability becomes current.

nodes.label: Earlier-of Debt Expiry
nodes.rationale: Active-stage debt expires at the earlier of fourteen days or the next stable customer-ready release and cannot outlive its immediate successor.

nodes.label: Single Canonical Writer Audit
nodes.rationale: Multiple frozen records can partition removal issues without authorizing more than one canonical implementation for a capability.

nodes.label: Current-Stage Added-Writer Rejection
nodes.rationale: The architecture checker rejects an added writer in the current migration stage by comparing persistence-call counts with the source revision.

nodes.label: Future Operation Digest and Call-Count Exactness
nodes.rationale: Future facade operations must retain both the frozen source digest and persistence-call count.

nodes.label: Architecture-Only Behavior Neutrality
nodes.rationale: The baseline changes architecture metadata and enforcement without changing persistence, business behavior, providers, customer data, or production authorization.

nodes.rationale: Talli competes through less scope, a clearer holding-company workflow, and lower price instead of matching a broad accounting suite.

nodes.label: Multi-Company Model Decision
nodes.rationale: Supporting multiple companies in the data model avoids future migration while a single-company-first UI keeps the initial experience simple.

nodes.label: Narrow Ledger Product Decision
nodes.rationale: A real but deliberately limited double-entry ledger is sufficient for the supported holding actions and annual filing loop.
